public_definitions: Unit condition '< 12,000 units' maps to 'Critical low-demand escalation level'.
Unit condition '< 25,000 units' maps to 'Low-demand review queue activation level'.
Unit condition '< 2,500 units from a decision threshold' maps to 'Manual merchandising verification variance band'.
Unit condition '>= 50,000 units' maps to 'Expanded replenishment planning level'.
Unit condition '>= 75,000 units' maps to 'Growth allocation review level'.
